home.heroTitle: Know the Oman property market before you commit
home.heroSubtitle: Neighborhood price trends, rental yields, and investment calculators for Oman — with every figure labeled by its source.
home.featureMarketBody: Average prices, rents, and yields per neighborhood, with historical trends.
home.featureCompareBody: Al Mouj vs Qurum vs Muscat Hills — side by side, on real data.
home.featureCalcBody: Rental yield, mortgage (conventional and Islamic), and full ROI projections in OMR.
home.dataHonestyBody: Every number on this platform carries a label: verified, official statistic, user-submitted, or AI-estimated — with a confidence score. We never dress up an estimate as a fact.
